title: The Grinning Surgeon
text: A man in a bloody apron has set up a table by the road, his saws and needles laid out in a neat, gleaming row. He smiles at every wound he sees, wider for the worse ones. He has fixed a great many people, he says, and he offers to fix one of yours.

options.label: Let him work on the one who needs it.

outcomes.text: His hands are quick and clean, and when he is done the old wound is gone.
He fixes it, and while he is in there he leaves a little something of his own.
He shrugs, and goes on smiling, and wipes a blade on his apron as you pass. The Leader keeps seeing that blade when they close their eyes.
